root_cause: Keyboard navigation in Pikaday does not respect the disableDayFn callback, allowing arrow keys to land on disabled weekend dates.
repair_strategy: Modify the _onKeyChange handler to repeatedly adjust the date in the direction of the pressed arrow key until a valid date (not disabled and within min/max) is found, terminating early if the date stops changing due to bounds.
expected_accessibility_effect: ArrowRight and ArrowLeft keys will skip over disabled weekend days, ensuring keyboard users can only navigate to selectable dates, improving compliance with WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard operability.
functional_risks: If all dates within the navigable range are disabled, the loop could become infinite; mitigated by breaking when the date stops changing due to bounds.
Performance impact is negligible as the loop iterates only over consecutive disabled dates (at most a few weeks).
Ensures min/max date boundaries are still honored; navigation will stop at the boundary even if that date is disabled.
verification_requirements: Verify that starting from Friday 2026-11-20, pressing ArrowRight results in the field value 2026-11-23 (skipping weekend).
Verify that pressing ArrowLeft from Monday 2026-11-23 results in 2026-11-20.
Verify that ArrowUp/ArrowDown shift by weeks while skipping weekends.
Verify that navigation stops at minDate and maxDate boundaries.
Verify that manual date entry and form submission still respect disableDayFn (validation).
